WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) cs
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns, c.cs, ROUND(m.ns-c.cs,2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.ns IS NULL OR c.cs IS NULL OR ABS(m.ns-c.cs)>0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=st.store_id
                 AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900 AND st.store_id<>999
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id=n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores ty_stores, ly.stores ly_stores,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) lfl_store_weeks
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
